releases.changelog:
1. Optimized the vibration effects in certain scenes for Switch console.

2. Added the ability to cancel back button mapping. When a button mapping is set for the back button, pressing the Setting button followed by the back button will cancel the current back button mapping, accompanied by a long vibration as a reminder.

3. Fixed an issue where having multiple back button mappings with button rapid fire functionality would affect other back buttons.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1. Optimized the startup connection speed.
2. Improved the output method when lightly pressing the trigger.
3. Enhanced vibration stability when the battery is low.
4. Improved wireless transmission stability.
5. Added a dead zone mode for the joysticks, with the default being no dead zone. You can set the joystick to have a dead zone mode by pressing the Set button and the Screenshot button, which will be accompanied by a short vibration as a reminder.
6. Fixed an issue where the back buttons couldn't map to the triggers in PC mode.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
